title: Keyboard input goes to the first Sticky Note instead of the clicked note in a wide panel
line: The reporter's open MR !1223 makes typing go into the clicked Sticky Note in a thick panel; verified on the rig.
explanation: Panels refuse keyboard focus until a widget asks for AcceptingInputStatus, but an inline Sticky Note only asked for it after it already had active focus, which it can never get first. So typing into a clicked note went to KRunner, and once the panel did take input it focused its first item, so later typing landed in the first note. The reporter's MR !1223 asks for input on press before forcing focus on the clicked editor, keeps it while that editor has focus, and releases it a turn later so switching between notes doesn't drop it.

commits.message:
notes: acquire panel input before focusing inline editors

Request panel keyboard interactivity before focusing a clicked inline note.
Retain accepting-input status for the focused inline editor and defer only
releasing the previous editor's status when focus changes between notes.

Keep saving synchronous before the inactive text binding restores noteText,
and exclude compact popup editors from panel input acquisition.

BUG: 527546

media.caption: Pure master, right panel 200 px with three inline notes: click note 2 and type MARK2, note 3 and MARK3, note 1 and MARK1.
Same steps with MR !1223: each text goes into the clicked note.
After clicking note 2 and typing MARK2: the text opened KRunner, the note stayed empty.
With the MR: MARK2 is in note 2.
Panel after typing into notes 2, 3 and 1: MARK3 and MARK1 both ended up in the first note.
With the MR: MARK2, MARK3 and MARK1 are each in the note that was clicked.
